pages.text: Burnt Bricks are a basic crafting component used in a bunch of machines in Mariculture. In order to craft them, you are going to need to place a brick or a nether brick, in to a vat filled with lava.
pages.title: Burnt Bricks

pages.text: After a short while of processing, indicated by the puffs of smoke, they will finish and you can simply remove them with a right click.

pages.title: Brick Construction Block
pages.text: Construction Blocks are used in various recipes as well.
